recipe.visualDefinition: A central, fluffy white cumulus cloud suspended in a deep blue atmospheric gradient, featuring vertical lens flare artifacts and a horizontal typographic band that bisects the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Central white cloud as the primary organic focal point against a deep blue void
Horizontal typographic axis cutting through the center of the cloud
Vertical symmetry established by light orbs and lens flares above and below the cloud
Contrast between the soft, irregular cloud edges and the rigid, geometric letterforms
coreInvariants: Deep blue to cyan vertical gradient background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A single cumulus cloud occupies the center 40% of the frame, acting as the primary subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cloud is the anchor, stabilized by a horizontal line of text that grounds the ethereal background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright cloud, moves horizontally across the main text, then vertically along the lens flare axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper and lower thirds creates a sense of vastness and depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cobalt and navy blue provide the atmospheric background and depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the cloud and secondary text provides high-value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red or coral for the primary display text creates a warm focal point against the cool background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the cloud and background; low saturation in the background with a vibrant pop in the central text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blues, whites, and one warm accent color

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters may feature subtle transparency or blending modes where they overlap the cloud

composition.relationshipToImage: Intersects the cloud, creating a layered depth effect

typesetting.alignment: Right-aligned or centered below primary text

composition.position: Below primary text, right-justified relative to the cloud
composition.overlap: Over the lower edge of the cloud

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, wide geometric sans for the title paired with a smaller, lighter grotesque sans for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Horizontal band of color or transparency behind text
Soft glow around the central cloud

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and circular counters.
Classic geometric proportions that match the wide-tracked look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a deep blue atmospheric gradient from navy at the top to cyan at the bottom. Place a single, detailed white cumulus cloud in the center. Add vertical lens flare artifacts and soft circular light orbs above and below the cloud.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of wide-tracked, bold geometric sans-serif text in coral red across the center of the cloud. Below it and to the right, add a smaller line of white sans-serif text with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text red and extremely wide-tracked?
Is the background a smooth blue gradient?
Are there visible lens flare orbs?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the accent text (red vs orange vs pink)
Gradient depth of the blue background
mustRedesign: Specific cloud shape to avoid copyright
Exact font choice (use similar geometric alternatives)
Specific placement of lens flare orbs

mustAchieve: High contrast between white cloud and blue sky

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth gradient transitions without banding
Ensure text is perfectly horizontal and centered
Verify that the red text is legible against both the cloud and the blue sky
Confirm lens flares do not obscure the primary text
recipe.reuseFormula: Central organic subject + atmospheric gradient background + wide-tracked geometric typography + vertical light artifacts.
